notes: The first draft's generic critique cycle was rejected even though its word counts passed. Every final critique was read individually against the frozen source and judgment rationales after bounded repairs, and the complete replay reports zero recurrent six-word boilerplate coverage.

The pro AI Contribution separates prediction constraints, a modal comparison space, and source identification; its dowsing discussion specifically distinguishes an anomalous effect from discovering its cause.

The con AI Contribution develops three different inferential proposals: revisable nonzero priors, a portfolio of independently risky predictions, and sensitivity analysis of disputed starting probabilities. These are not mirrored rewrites of the pro paragraphs.

Both reconstructed conclusions begin with Therefore because they conclude explicit premise chains, but their content and qualification differ substantively; this is useful logical parallelism, not an interchangeable generation scaffold.

The novelty map identifies the live source moves being extended and marks the prediction portfolio as genuinely new reasoning. The section-level disclosure distinguishes all such material from speaker performance and scores.

Ordinary commas, apostrophes, colons, semicolons, and terminal punctuation remain intact. The complete-corpus punctuation screen flagged no debate, and neither the independent nor recent comparison window shares a six-word sequence with this AI Contribution.

One repaired sentence initially confused favorable likelihood with posterior support. A separately authorized single-leaf replacement corrected only that clause, preserving the remaining three sentences and the fixed score.
